items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the education law, in relation to requiring state and federal
criminal background checks as a condition for licensure as a physician
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S6620

SPONSOR: BIAGGI
 
TITLE OF BILL:  An act to amend the education law, in relation to
requiring state and federal criminal background checks as a condition
for licensure as a physician

 
PURPOSE:

To ensure that patients in the state of New York are in the safest hands
while receiving treatment from a medical professional.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1 amends section 6524 of the education law by adding 6-a, a new
subdivision. This amendment will require applicants seeking a physi-
cian's license to pass both state and federal background checks.  The
applicant shall be financially responsible for such background checks.

Section 2 sets forth an effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

New York is one of 14 states that does not require prospective physi-
cians to undergo federal and/or state criminal background checks in
order to practice medicine. Currently, New York depends on medical
professionals to self-disclose any background of criminal history on
license applications, and to then notify their medical board of any new
charges. Unfortunately, disclosure of this information does not always
happen, and it is the patients they serve who are left most vulnerable.

It is necessary that state and federal background checks are required in
order for an applicant to obtain a physician's license because this
measure will ensure the safety of patients and promote the integrity of
the healthcare system in New York State. The addition of background
checks provides an early check on healthcare professionals and it demon-
strates that New York has done its due diligence in assessing the safety
and competence of physician applicants for licensure.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New bill.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

To be determined.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
Immediately.

summary: Requires an applicant to pass a federal and state criminal background check as a requirement to be licensed as a physician.
title: Relates to requiring criminal background checks as a requirement for licensure as a physician
